# Rule: Reordered override set is not a change

_Canonical rule slug:_ `public-virtual-dispatch-set-reordered`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A public virtual method's override set is the same but its dispatch edges are listed in another order; the comparison is over sets, so this produces no finding.
